entries.title: Job 6:1
segments: And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 6:2
segments: Oh that my grief were but weighed, and my ruin laid in the balances together!

entries.title: Job 6:3
segments: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea; therefore my words have been rash.

entries.title: Job 6:4
segments: For the arrows of the Almighty [are] within me, their fury [is] drinking my spirit; the terrors of God are set against me.

entries.title: Job 6:5
segments: Does the wild ass bray [when he has] grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

entries.title: Job 6:6
segments: Can that which has no taste be eaten without salt? Or is there taste in the white of an egg?

entries.title: Job 6:7
segments: My soul refuses to touch them; they [are] sickening food to me.

entries.title: Job 6:8
segments: Oh that I might have my desire, and that God would grant the thing that I long for!

entries.title: Job 6:9
segments: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that He would loose His hand and cut me off!

entries.title: Job 6:10
segments: And it is yet my comfort; yea, I would rejoice in pain, though He did not spare me; for I have not hidden the words of the Holy One.

entries.title: Job 6:11
segments: What [is] my strength, that I should hope? And what [is] my end, that I should be patient?

entries.title: Job 6:12
segments: [Is] my strength the strength of stones? Or [is] my flesh bronze?

entries.title: Job 6:13
segments: [Is] not my help in me? And is wisdom fully driven away from me?

entries.title: Job 6:14
segments: To him who is afflicted, pity is [due] from his friend, but he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 6:15
segments: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a torrent; they pass away as the streams of torrents,

entries.title: Job 6:16
segments: [torrents] black from ice, in which the snow hides itself.

entries.title: Job 6:17
segments: When they become warm, they go away; when it is hot, they vanish out of their place.

entries.title: Job 6:18
segments: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing and are lost.

entries.title: Job 6:19
segments: The troops of Tema looked; the companies of Sheba hoped for them.

entries.title: Job 6:20
segments: They were ashamed because they had hoped; they came there and were ashamed.

entries.title: Job 6:21
segments: Surely now you are like them; you see [my] casting down, and are afraid.

entries.title: Job 6:22
segments: Did I say, Give to me? or, Offer a bribe for me from your wealth;

entries.title: Job 6:23
segments: or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand; or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

entries.title: Job 6:24
segments: Teach me, and I will be silent; and cause me to understand where I have gone astray.

entries.title: Job 6:25
segments: Right words are powerful, but what does your arguing argue?

entries.title: Job 6:26
segments: Do you intend to criticize words, and the speeches of one who is hopeless, [that are] as wind?

entries.title: Job 6:27
segments: Yea, you cause [anger] to fall on the fatherless, and you dig [a pit] for your friend.

entries.title: Job 6:28
segments: And now, please look on me; for if I lie, [it is] before your face.

entries.title: Job 6:29
segments: Turn back, please let there be no sin; yea, return again, my righteousness [is] in this matter.

entries.title: Job 6:30
segments: Is there wrong in my tongue? Cannot my taste discern desirable things?
